# fianu_entity_pod (Resource)

Attaches a pod to a Fianu entity. Pods are living configuration — JSON-valued rows keyed by `(entity_id, pod_type, key)` that change how an entity behaves without minting a new entity version.

This is the generic form: `value` is a JSON string you author with `jsonencode({...})`, so pod types the provider has no typed resource for still work. For notification pods, prefer `fianu_notification`, which validates the same payload and exposes it as real HCL.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a platform-capability pod to a gate, letting JFrog act as a gating
# source for this gate's checks.
#
# fianu_entity_pod is the generic form: `value` is whatever JSON the pod type
# expects. For notification pods use fianu_notification instead — it validates
# the same payload and exposes it as real HCL.

resource "fianu_entity_pod" "jfrog_gating" {
  entity_uuid = fianu_gate.deploy.uuid
  pod_type    = "platforms_capabilities_data_exports_gating"
  key         = "gatingSource:jf-prod"

  name        = "JFrog production gating"
  description = "Defer this gate's verdict to JFrog's own evaluation."

  value = jsonencode({
    capability  = "gatingSource"
    instanceKey = "jf-prod"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_uuid` (String) UUID of the entity this pod hangs off (e.g., `fianu_gate.deploy.uuid`, `fianu_control.sast.uuid`).
- `key` (String) Pod key, unique per `(entity, pod_type)`. Many pod types use a structured key to fan out — platform-capability pods use `"<capability>:<instanceKey>"`, notification pods use `"config"`.
- `pod_type` (String) The pod type bucket, e.g. `platforms_capabilities_data_exports_gating`, `display`, `llm_context_rule`. See the Fianu Console pod catalog for the types valid on a given entity.
- `value` (String) The pod's JSON payload. Author with `jsonencode({...})`. The shape is defined by `pod_type` and validated server-side on write.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the pod is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the pod.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite resource ID — `<entity_uuid>/<pod_type>/<key>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Pods are addressed by the (entity, pod_type, key) triple.
terraform import fianu_entity_pod.jfrog_gating '<entity_uuid>/platforms_capabilities_data_exports_gating/gatingSource:jf-prod'
```
